title: Capability
description: An operation the system is willing to perform, with a contract the runtime can validate. The model sees capabilities, never implementation details.

input.description: A map of argument name to a type descriptor.

output.description: A map of result name to a type descriptor.

permission.description: What the capability may do to the machine.

confirmation.description: Whether the capability asks before running.

context_requirements.description: Context fields this capability needs to be resolvable.

executor.description: Where the side effect happens. Only the runtime chooses an executor; the model never does.
